name: Ufo
overview: Scripture describes extraordinary heavenly phenomena often involving clouds, fire, and brightness, which are manifestations of God's presence and angelic activity rather than unidentified flying objects. Passages such as Ezekiel 1:4 and Psalms 68:17 depict divine chariots and angelic hosts in awe-inspiring displays, while prophetic visions in Daniel 7:13 and the Gospels (Matthew 24:30; Mark 13:26) reveal the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven in power and glory. These biblical accounts affirm that what might be perceived as 'ufos' are in fact divine or angelic appearances serving God's sovereign purposes.
